newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable amid ample liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable amid ample liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in slow late trading on Thursday amid ample rupiah supply in the money market, dealers said.
One European bank dealer said there seemed to be some attempts to test the downside of the dollar-rupiah intervention band, reflected by sustained dollar unloading from offshore.
Spot rupiah was at 2,431.75/32.25 at 0830 GMT against an opening of 2,432.30/32.80. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,430.90/31.40 and 2,430.5/31.0, respectively.
The dealer said the rupiah was not affected by excess rupiah supply because the dollar was also well offered.
Overnight rupiah fell to three percent in the afternoon from 14.0 percent at the opening. Overnight dollar was offered at 5.5 percent. Overnight swap ended at 0.30/0.38 points.
Dealers said market focus was on liquidity next Tuesday and Friday when weekly tax payments will be due at mid-month.
Swap premiums were little changed. The European bank dealer said the rates were expensive, probably reflecting the on-going jitters in the region of possible attack by specualtors.
One-month swaps were at 13.75/14.75, two at 29.0/31.0, three at 44.0/45.0 and six at 89.0/90.0 points.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,430/2,622 and the conversion band also by one point to 2,430/2,478 on Thursday.
